title: Blind CAS Loop without Backoff (Bus Lock Storm)
pattern: A tight Compare-and-Swap (CAS) retry loop that spins blindly on failure under high thread contention without yielding or backing off.
why_bad: Under high contention, multiple CPUs constantly issue cache invalidate and write commands to the same cache line. This triggers a "bus lock storm," saturating the interconnect fabric, stalling all CPU pipelines, and degrading system-wide performance.
detection: A loop containing a weak or strong CAS retry block with no yield, sleep, or backoff operations on the failure path.
counterexample: The loop body contains an explicit exponential backoff or spin-loop yield.
